description: This collection contains simulated video transmission and performance outputs for horizontal and vertical handover using Proxy Mobile IPv6. Multimedia University researchers in Cyberjaya compare mobility-management behaviour across homogeneous and heterogeneous wireless networks. The repository describes delay, throughput, jitter, packet loss and reconstructed-video quality metrics, with the article explaining trace-based sending and receiving times. Mendeley version 2 provides one simulation-and-video ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0. The enclosed tabular formats and exact simulated time horizon were not established from the file inventory. Coverage is a location-independent network experiment, and protocol settings and chosen video traces are limitations for generalization to operating mobile networks. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing handover penalties and quality-of-service assumptions in wireless simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without a verified import or claim that it produced this release. No archive, video or simulation was downloaded or executed.
